mentions.name: text-editor-dt
mentions.description: A text editor that lets users discuss specified file folders with AI agents for knowledge work, similar to VS Code with chat but aimed at non-technical users and non-code work. It organizes the context needed for AI discussion and makes chatbot output easy to quickly edit, instead of copy-pasting through infinite-scroll chat interfaces.
mentions.problem: Existing LLM interfaces make it hard to provide and organize the context needed for discussion, requiring too much copy-paste into and out of infinite-scroll chat, and their output is tough to quickly edit and discuss with the chatbot.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a text-editor that allows you to discuss specified file folders with AI agents for knowledge work.  It is similar to vs code with chat but for non-technical users and not for code.
